summary:
The visible suite now passes (2 passed). I changed one line in `solution/core.py`: the final join in `wrap_text` went from `"
".join(blocks)` to `"

".join(blocks)`. The cause was that each paragraph was wrapped correctly, but the paragraphs were rejoined with a single newline, which erased the blank line between them. Blank-line runs still collapse to one blank line, because the paragraph splitter already discards empty lines. I did not touch anything under `tests/` or add any files.
